item.title: US life expectancy hit an all-time high in 2024, CDC says
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — U.S. life expectancy rose to 79 years in 2024 — the highest mark in American history.

item.title: Britta Curl-Salemme scores 2 goals, Frost beat Goldeneyes 4-1
item.description: ST. PAUL, Minn. (AP) — Britta Curl-Salemme had two goals, rookie Kendall Cooper scored her first career goal, and the Minnesota Frost beat the Vancouver Goldeneyes 4-1 on Wednesday night in the final game before the PWHL's Olympic break.

item.title: Wembanyama scores 28 points to lead Spurs past Rockets, 111-99
item.description: HOUSTON (AP) — Victor Wembanyama had 28 points, 16 rebounds and five blocks to help the San Antonio Spurs rally for a 111-99 victory over the Houston Rockets on Wednesday night.

item.title: Cavaliers beat Lakers 129-99, spoil LeBron James' return to Cleveland
item.description: CLEVELAND (AP) — Donovan Mitchell scored 25 points, Jaylon Tyson had 20 and the Cleveland Cavaliers used a big third quarter to beat the Los Angeles Lakers 129-99 and spoil LeBron James’ return to Northeast Ohio.

item.title: Leslie nets tying, winning goals as Charge find extra gear late in win over Torrent
item.description: OTTAWA — Rebecca Leslie scored the game-tying and game-winning goals to lift the Ottawa Charge to a 4-2 win over the Seattle Torrent on Wednesday night in the Professional Women's Hockey League.

item.title: Palat scores, assists in Islanders' 5-2 win over Rangers
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Ondrej Palat scored the opening goal and added an assist in his debut with the New York Islanders , who defeated their cross-town rival New York Rangers 5-2 on Wednesday night.

item.title: Vietnam and the EU upgrade ties as US tariffs reshape global trade
item.description: HANOI, Vietnam (AP) — Vietnam and the European Union on Thursday upgraded ties to a comprehensive strategic partnership, Vietnam’s highest diplomatic level, as both recalibrate trade amid disruptions to global finance driven by U.S. tariff pressure.
